high_level_description: This image captures a striking architectural structure featuring a large, bronze-colored statue of a winged horse (Pegasus) perched atop a pedestal. The Pegasus is depicted in mid-flight, with its wings spread wide and its mane flowing behind it, symbolizing freedom and aspiration. The pedestal on which the Pegasus stands is part of a larger monument or sculpture, characterized by a modern design with angular, geometric shapes and a white marble-like finish. The structure includes a large archway that frames the Pegasus, adding to the grandeur of the scene.
